function BenillaShardSelector_Refresh() local f = BenillaShardSelector local on, inArea, shard, count = GetPlayerShardInfo() if not (on and inArea) then if f:IsShown() then f:Hide() end return end if not f:IsShown() then f:Show() end BenillaShardSelectorText:SetText(BENILLA_SHARD_TEXT.shard .. " |cffffffff" .. shard .. " / " .. count .. "|r") if count > 1 then BenillaShardSelectorPrev:Enable() BenillaShardSelectorNext:Enable() else BenillaShardSelectorPrev:Disable() BenillaShardSelectorNext:Disable() end end
-- One step through this area's shards, wrapping; the area takes `playerShard` modulo its -- count, so the wrapped index is the one written. function BenillaShardSelector_Step(delta) local on, inArea, shard, count = GetPlayerShardInfo() if not (on and inArea) or count < 2 then return end local n = shard - 1 + delta if n < 0 then n = count - 1 elseif n >= count then n = 0 end SetCVar("playerShard", tostring(n)) BenillaShardSelector_Refresh() end
function BenillaShardSelector_ShowTooltip(owner) GameTooltip:SetOwner(owner, "ANCHOR_BOTTOM") GameTooltip:SetText(BENILLA_SHARD_TEXT.title) GameTooltip:AddLine(BENILLA_SHARD_TEXT.help, 1, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:Show() end

Scripts.OnUpdate: this.wait = (this.wait or 0) - arg1 if this.wait > 0 then return end this.wait = 0.25 BenillaShardSelector_Refresh()
